name: 混沌控制
description: 传送至5格内未被占据的空地或掩体，使7格内敌人获得沉默与定身1回合。
code: function executeSkill(context){var c=context.piece,b=context.battle,pos=selectTarget({type:'grid',range:5,filter:'all'});if(!pos||pos.needsTargetSelection)return pos;var tile=b.map.tiles.find(function(t){return t.x===pos.x&&t.y===pos.y;});if(!tile||!tile.props.walkable||(tile.props.type!=='floor'&&tile.props.type!=='cover')||b.pieces.some(function(p){return p.currentHp>0&&p.x===pos.x&&p.y===pos.y;}))return {success:false,message:'目标必须是未被占据的空地或掩体'};c.x=pos.x;c.y=pos.y;var affected=0;b.pieces.filter(function(p){return p.currentHp>0&&p.ownerPlayerId!==c.ownerPlayerId&&Math.max(Math.abs(p.x-c.x),Math.abs(p.y-c.y))<=7;}).forEach(function(p){p.statusTags=p.statusTags||[];var silenced=p.statusTags.find(function(t){return t.type==='silenced';});if(silenced){silenced.currentDuration=1;silenced.remainingDuration=1;}else{p.statusTags.push({id:'silenced-'+p.instanceId,type:'silenced',name:'沉默',stacks:1,currentDuration:1,remainingDuration:1,relatedRules:['rule-silenced-block']});addRuleById(p.instanceId,'rule-silenced-block');}var immobilized=p.statusTags.find(function(t){return t.type==='chidori-immobile';});if(immobilized){immobilized.currentDuration=1;immobilized.remainingDuration=1;}else{p.statusTags.push({id:'immobile-'+p.instanceId,type:'chidori-immobile',name:'定身',stacks:1,currentDuration:1,remainingDuration:1,relatedRules:['rule-chidori-immobile']});addRuleById(p.instanceId,'rule-chidori-immobile');}affected++;});return {success:true,message:'混沌控制生效，'+affected+'名敌人被沉默并定身1回合'};}
